subject: PolarisAI: service surge impact and commercial remediation
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@polarisai.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@polarisai.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: High latency/5xx spike impacting PolarisAI inference - request for remediation and credits

Hi Markus,

We had a significant incident across several production endpoints overnight (2028-07-10 23:00 UTC -> 2028-07-11 03:45 UTC) where latency jumped to 2.5x baseline and a sustained 5xx error rate of ~6% for our batch scoring traffic. This impacted 3 customer integrations and increased our downstream SLAs exposure.

Our infra team collected traces and request-level metrics (attached: polaris_usecase_metrics.csv). Key asks:
- A timeline of what caused the regression and what fix is in place
- An immediate remediation plan and the corrective actions we can expect in the next 72 hours
- Commercial remediation (SLA credits) for impact window and any lost API calls we need to reprocess

This is material for us — our CFO (Tom) is copied and may request executive engagement. Please treat as urgent; we need a concrete proposal by EOD PT today.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
VP Engineering, PolarisAI
alyssa.chen@polarisai.com
+1 415-555-0189

Attachment: polaris_usecase_metrics.csv (CSV export, 28KB)

Ben / Evelyn — forwarding Polaris' alert. Alyssa sent metrics and is requesting a remediation plan + credits by EOD PT. Tom (CFO) is on the thread.

Immediate priorities:
1) Root cause summary + short-term mitigation (what's fixed already?)
2) Commercial proposal for credits/refund and any goodwill options (free dedicated capacity trial, priority scheduling, etc.)
3) Exec call availability (Markus, Ben, Alyssa + Tom) — please suggest windows.

Ben — can you draft a credit offer we can present? Evelyn — loop in Legal if needed for wording. Marissa, please flag Finance if this needs approval beyond standard credits.

Thanks,
Markus

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PolarisAI incident - draft commercial remediation

Markus / team / Alyssa —

Thanks for the heads up and the metrics, Alyssa. We've pulled our telemetry and logs for the same window and correlated the spikes to a routing regression that increased cross-tenant KV cache misses on a small subset of worker pools. The ops team pushed a fix at 02:10 UTC that restored baseline latency; we've retained pre- and post-fix traces and are continuing deeper analysis.

Commercial remediation (draft):
- Credit equal to 15% of PolarisAI's July 2028 monthly invoice applied to the Aug invoice.
- One-time 30-day trial of a dedicated capacity pool (up to 2 reserved GPUs) to support peak batch scoring windows free of charge.
- Priority support hours for the next 90 days and an ops-runbook review session with our reliability engineers.

Attachments: proposed_credit_schedule.pdf (PDF, draft).

Alyssa — does that align with what Polaris would accept as a starting point? If yes, we'll fast-track a legal amendment and prepare a DocuSign. If Polaris needs a different structure (flat dollar amount or formulaic per-call refund), let us know and we'll model it.

Availability for exec call: Wed 2028-07-12 11:00-12:30 PT or Thu 2028-07-13 09:00-11:00 PT.

-Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@polarisai.com>, Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@polarisai.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, PolarisAI Legal <legal@polarisai.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PolarisAI incident - proposed remediation & contract amendment

Hi Alyssa / Tom —

Thanks for the prompt data; appreciate the patience while we quantified the impact. Below is a concise summary we will include in the amendment:

Impact summary (proposed language):
- Incident window: 2028-07-10T23:00:00Z -> 2028-07-11T03:45:00Z.
- Measured elevated 95th percentile latency (2.5x baseline) and averaged 5xx error rate of 6% for affected endpoints.
- Impacted calls estimated: ~78K inference requests across three customer integrations.

Commercial remediation (final proposal):
1) Credit: 15% of July 2028 invoice applied to PolarisAI's August 2028 invoice.
2) Supplemental option: Alternatively, a per-request refund formula of $0.0035 per failed request (estimated refund cap $273).
3) Goodwill: 30-day dedicated capacity trial (up to 2 reserved GPUs) plus two 2-hour runbook sessions with our reliability team.

We will prepare a short amendment (2-3 clauses) clarifying the incident window, credit mechanics, and a mutual non-admission clause. If Polaris' legal accepts, we can route via DocuSign for signatures.

Please see the draft credit schedule attached and the proposed DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/doc/ZX-PL-2345

Next steps:
- Alyssa / Tom: confirm preferred credit structure (percentage vs per-request)
- Polaris Legal: confirm acceptance of amendment wording or propose edits
- Agree exec call time to review details — Ben proposed Wed 11:00-12:30 PT or Thu 09:00-11:00 PT.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success Operations, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai

Attachment: proposed_credit_schedule.pdf
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@polarisai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@polarisai.com>, PolarisAI Legal <legal@polarisai.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jul 2028 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PolarisAI incident - proposed remediation & contract amendment

Evelyn / Ben / Markus —

Thank you for the quick investigation and the concrete proposal. Polaris prefers the percentage credit applied to the Aug invoice (option 1) and would like the dedicated capacity trial to start within the next 14 days. Polaris Legal will review the amendment and route any redlines; Tom and I are available for the exec call on Thu 2028-07-13 09:00 PT if you can make that slot (Ben suggested it).

One small ask on the amendment wording: please include an explicit clause that credits do not preclude Polaris from requesting per-call remediation should downstream customers be demonstrably impacted and provide proof. We'll mark that for Legal to review.

We'll review the DocuSign when received. Appreciate the proactive remediation and the trial offer — that will help stabilize our operations while we reprocess the missed calls.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
VP Engineering, PolarisAI
